## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Siena, Italy. It starts at Piazza Pio II 2.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Enter a world of thrilling history and beautiful architecture - plus peek inside the pope's bedroom - at Pienza's magnificent Piccolomini Palace, built for Pope Pius II in the 15th century! Explore Renaissance life through its sumptuous architecture, priceless artworks and artifacts, and get inspired by the cool contemporary art gallery.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €11.25. It was rated 4.1 out of 5 from 17 ratings and 4 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
